what: Copy-paste setup for every client that accepts a pasted remote MCP URL. Rendered to distribution/connect/connect-matrix.json and shown on /connect/. {free} and {full} are replaced by the two doors at render time; no other URL may appear. scripts/harness-x/connect-live.mjs checks every block against the live doors (initialize + tools/list for each URL; JSON blocks must parse; the curl block is executed) and writes distribution/connect/connect-live-check.json. Client UIs and CLIs are not driven by that check: those steps are copied from each vendor's documentation, linked per row.

free.what: read-only tools, no sign-in, nothing on it moves money

full.what: the free tools plus x402-metered evidence tools; a metered tool answers with a payment challenge until the caller's own wallet signs one

tool_counts.note: array lengths of functions/mcp/gspc-tools.json and paid-tools.json at render time

tools[] of a Responses API request

clients.snippet:
from xai_sdk.tools import mcp

tools = [mcp(server_url="https://councilof.ai/mcp/free", server_label="gspc")]

from google.adk.tools.mcp_tool.mcp_toolset import McpToolset
from google.adk.tools.mcp_tool.mcp_session_manager import StreamableHTTPConnectionParams

gspc = McpToolset(connection_params=StreamableHTTPConnectionParams(url="https://councilof.ai/mcp"))

from langchain_mcp_adapters.client import MultiServerMCPClient

client = MultiServerMCPClient({"gspc": {"transport": "streamable_http", "url": "https://councilof.ai/mcp"}})
tools = await client.get_tools()
